question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Upright**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Corrupt)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Upright"** refers to a person who is honest, moral, and holds a high ethical standard. (ईमानदार, सच्चा, या नैतिक)
 
 
• **Example:** The upright judge was respected for his fairness and integrity in all cases.
 
 
• The word **"Corrupt"** is the antonym of upright and refers to someone or something that is dishonest, immoral, or engages in unethical practices. (भ्रष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** The official was removed from his post due to his corrupt practices.
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **"Upright"** is **"Corrupt"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Corrupt)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Honest **(ईमानदार): Being truthful and sincere in one’s actions and words.
 
 
• **Example:** An honest person never hides the truth, even if it is inconvenient.
 
 
 
• **Ethical **(नैतिक): Following moral principles and doing what is right.
 
 
• **Example:** The company’s ethical policies ensured fair treatment of all employees.
 
 
 
• **Noble** (महान): Having or showing fine personal qualities or high moral principles.
 
 
• **Example:** The noble act of donating to charity inspired many people.
